name: workeros
description: The open-source, self-hosted runtime for AI workers. Sandboxed by default.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${WORKEROS_API_PORT:-8000} --reload
scripts.dev: echo 'Run dev:api and dev:web in separate terminals'
